name: Block-based Volume Rendering Strategy
definition: A rendering strategy for large scenes partitioned into blocks, where each block uses a separate shader due to web texture unit limits. Blocks are rendered sequentially and combined to maintain 3D consistency and correct occlusion.
summary: Block-based Volume Rendering Strategy partitions large scenes into blocks with separate shaders to overcome web texture limits, ensuring 3D consistency through sequential back-to-front sorting and accumulation.
